name: 狂想空间II
group_note: ES II/Annihilator-derived mudlib (狂想空间II, 'Wild Imagination Space II'), distinct lineage from the jyqxc family (driver-native plaintext save format, not the legacy binary encoding). Two bugs fixed: (1) 358 files used AGENTS.md-§6.1-class angle-bracket absolute #include paths (e.g. #include </open/open.h>), which this driver resolves relative to the configured include directory rather than mudlib root -- too many scattered occurrences to hand-edit, so applied the documented bulk fix instead: added master.lpc's include_file(compiled, from, path) apply, prepending an extra '/' to force absolute-looking <> includes through the same merge()-based resolution quoted includes get. (2) adm/daemons/natured.lpc's check_heart_beat() had a stray semicolon terminating an if-condition early (`if (wizardp(...) && ...);`), making the following call_other() to a nonexistent daemon /adm/daemons/temp.lpc run unconditionally on every heartbeat tick (every second, forever) -- confirmed the file was never present anywhere in this codebase (a cut dev/debug scratch daemon whose two call sites were never cleaned up); removed both dead call sites rather than fabricate a replacement daemon. Registration uses a distinctive interactive point-buy flow (7 explicit stat prompts drawing from a shared 160-point pool, the 8th stat auto-filled from the remainder) instead of the jyqxc family's auto-generate-then-accept pattern. Admin level convention here is (manager), one tier above (admin) -- seeded fluffos as (manager) via adm/etc/wizlist to match the two pre-existing entries. Full registration->look->score->quit and admin flow verified before and after the LPC formatter pass; formatter reverted 6 genuinely corrupted files (stray '\ n' mis-tokenization inside Chinese-heavy string literals -- a new corruption shape not seen in the jyqxc family, distinct from that family's ASCII-art-map collapse pattern). Several very-large-diff files (thousands of lines removed) were verified as the formatter correctly stripping thousands of pre-existing trailing blank lines, not corruption.
